motion: The camera does not move. Rain streams down the bus window in thick running lines. The woman keeps looking down at the glowing phone in her hands for a moment, then slowly lifts her eyes from it, lowers the phone to her lap, and turns her head to look out of the window at the closed, whitewashed bank across the street. She stays very still, looking at it. The street lights shimmer through the rain on the glass. The camera does not move.
